SELECT sar.area_name AS provinceName, pi.province_id AS provinceId, sa.area_name AS cityName, sa.longitude as longitude, sa.latitude as latitude, pi.city_id AS cityId, pi.visit_type AS visitType, CASE WHEN pi.visit_type = 1 THEN 'hospitalPatient' WHEN pi.visit_type = 2 THEN 'outPatient' WHEN pi.visit_type = 3 THEN 'emergencyPatient' WHEN pi.visit_type = 4 THEN 'testPatient' ELSE 'otherPatient' END AS visitName, count( pi.patient_id ) AS patientCount FROM ( SELECT max( patient_id) AS patient_id FROM patient_info WHERE city_id IS NOT NULL AND visit_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY account_id ) s INNER JOIN patient_info pi ON s.patient_id = pi.patient_id INNER JOIN sys_area sa ON sa.area_code = pi.city_id INNER JOIN sys_area sar ON sar.area_code = pi.province_id
and to_days(pi.create_time) = to_days(CURRENT_DATE)
and pi.province_id = #{provinceId}
GROUP BY pi.province_id, pi.city_id, pi.visit_type ORDER BY count(pi.patient_id)

and to_days(pi.create_time) = to_days(CURRENT_DATE)
and pi.province_id = #{provinceId}
GROUP BY pi.province_id, pi.city_id, pi.visit_type ORDER BY count(pi.patient_id)
